anomalies.observed: The VCAP pins on both MCUs are connected to external interface nets: FCC2.48 and FCC2.73 go to connector nets NET0017 and NET0094; NAVC2.31 goes to connector net NET0081, and NAVC2.47 goes to NET0137, the USB debug D+ net. No VCAP-to-GND capacitors are shown.
anomalies.expected: Each MCU's VCAP pin should have its required capacitor to GND and should not be connected to external interface signals. These connections should be corrected before board fabrication.

evidence.quote: FCC2: VCAP pin 48 NET0017; VCAP pin 73 NET0094 (FCC sheet, page 2).
UART3_FCC2 connector pins 3 and 4: NET0017 and NET0094 (FCC Peripherals sheet, page 5).
NAVC2: VCAP_1 pin 31 NET0081; VCAP_2 pin 47 NET0137 (NAVC sheet, page 3).
NET0081 on the I2C3_NAVC2 connector (NAVC Peripherals sheet, page 6); NET0137 on the USB debug D+ line (Connections sheet, page 4).

anomalies.impact: The MCU internal core-regulator outputs are improperly loaded or driven by external interface circuitry instead of being properly decoupled. This can prevent either MCU from starting or operating reliably and can cause contention on the connected interfaces.

parsed.summary: An anomaly is present: the VCAP pins on both MCUs are routed to external connector or USB signals, with no VCAP decoupling capacitors shown. This violates the required VCAP connections and can compromise MCU operation.
